A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SpaceControl. All 18 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–D, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results in Tables 1–2, a 52-participant user study, and qualitative generation, editing and local-control experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, user-study outcomes and qualitative experiments, including those in Appendix A.

M1.justification: The geometry encoding, latent noising, structure generation and appearance generation procedures remain unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same local semantic conditioning mechanism and equally weighted global/local cross-attention.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate primitive- and mesh-conditioned generation on ShapeNet chairs/tables and Toys4K, and describe ABO training for SPICE-E-T. Image conditioning, editing, scene assembly and local-control examples already appear in v1.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain Coin3D, Spice-E, SPICE-E-T and reference-only Trellis, including Spice-E's stylization checkpoint for mesh conditioning. The user study retains Spice-E and SPICE-E-T. Revised descriptions do not establish changes to the evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The metrics, Trellis backbone, control-parameter settings and user-study design remain unchanged. Appendix D retains 120,000 training iterations and batch size 4. Revised table captions explain metrics already used in v1.

E4.justification: The control-strength sensitivity, image-conditioning and spatial-alignment analyses are retained, as are Appendix A's editing, scene and local-control demonstrations. The added superquadric illustration explains the representation rather than adding an experimental analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates and user-study preference proportions without repeated-run or seed counts, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–2 and all user-study percentages match. For example, SpaceControl's Toys4K CD remains 14.0 for primitives and 4.89 for meshes in Table 1. The qualitative outputs and reported findings are also retained.

T1.justification: The rectified-flow equations, timestep transformation, superquadric definition, guidance equation and Appendix A.4 attention formula are unchanged. No theorem, proof or substantive mathematical derivation is added.

C1.justification: Both versions claim training-free spatial control, adjustable faithfulness versus realism, stronger geometric alignment and an interactive editing interface. The added scene-related discussion presents future possibilities rather than a new demonstrated core contribution.

C2.justification: Section 6 replaces explicit limitations framing with future-work discussion, dropping the direct warning about difficulties automating generation without per-instance tuning. It adds adaptive control scheduling and possible integration with scene abstractions, functional scene graphs and digital-cousin generation.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement changes from promising code release upon acceptance to reporting public availability through the project page. Implementation and training details, including Appendix D, otherwise remain unchanged; external availability was not independently checked.

R1.justification: v2 adds GuideFlow3D, P2P-Bridge, Search3D, OpenFunGraph and digital-cousin references, and removes Corsetti et al. It also changes Coin3D's characterization from inference-only guidance to combining fine-tuning with test-time optimization. The central research positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Substantial rewriting spans the abstract, introduction, related work, preliminary explanations, experiment descriptions and conclusion. Several numbered subsections become run-in headings, and qualitative results are incorporated into Section 5.1. This is extensive editorial restructuring despite stable methods and experiments.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figure 3 illustrating superquadric primitives, reformats captions and clarifies the metric descriptions in Tables 1–2. Existing figures are retained and subsequently renumbered, with modest sizing, spacing and page-layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: Clearer baseline descriptions, fuller metric captions and the new superquadric illustration improve exposition, while the reproducibility statement now reports public code access. These limited gains outweigh the less explicit limitations discussion and duplicated Section 4.2 cross-reference. The method and empirical support remain unchanged.
